# For the Animals: An Argument Guide

> The argument guide for animal advocates systematically catalogs every idea used to exploit, harm or kill animals or to avoid helping them, with a thorough explanation of the objections and biases of people who oppose veganism and antispeciesism.

A free, open site, with no sign-up. Each argument has a page with the strongest version of the objection, what it gets right, where it fails, a short answer and the sources.

## How to use

- [Start here](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/start-here.html): the sentience criterion, the guide's commitments and the difference between direct and indirect arguments
- [About the guide](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/about.html): what the project is, how sources are handled and what tone it takes

## Arguments

- [All arguments](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/#arguments): the 220 arguments used against veganism and antispeciesism, each with its main flaw
- [The families](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/families.html): the arguments grouped by their underlying question and dominant error
- [The anti-vegan line of reasoning](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/reasoning.html): where the conversation goes after each objection is answered
- [Map of connections](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/map.html): the chains of objections and the three roots where almost every conversation ends
- [Political objections](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/political-objections.html): what each ethical or political theory says to exclude animals, and why that contradicts its own principle

## Errors and vocabulary

- [Fallacies](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/fallacies.html): the logical errors that explain much of the catalogue
- [Biases](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/biases.html): the psychological mechanisms that make these arguments convincing
- [Glossary](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/glossary.html): the terms of animal ethics, veganism and the debate on animal exploitation

## For the movement itself

- [Stop saying this](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/stop-saying.html): 64 arguments used by vegans that do not survive scrutiny, and how to say them better
- [Beyond veganism](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/beyond-veganism.html): antispeciesism and sentientism, wild animals, digital minds and the currents of the movement

## Practice

- [Simulated debate](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/debate.html): pick the best answer and see where the conversation goes
- [Practice answers](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/practice.html): cards with the objection on one side and the main flaw on the other
- [Library](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/library.html): books and websites for learning to argue for animals

## Full list

- [Every argument, with its main flaw](https://fortheanimals.biblioverse.org/llms-full.txt)

Portuguese version: https://pelosanimais.biblioverse.org/
